List available CATE simulation methods

Source: R/sim-cate-benchmarks.R
sim_cate_methods.Rd

Returns the names of all estimator methods registered for use with sim_cate_one_rep() and sim_cate_run().

Usage

sim_cate_methods()

Value

Character vector of registered method names.

Details

NameDescription
dnn_oracleProposed DNN Z-estimator, L2 distance, oracle nuisances
dnn_oracle_mahalProposed DNN Z-estimator, Mahalanobis distance, oracle nuisances (dgp5_correlated)
dnn_fullsampleProposed DNN Z-estimator, L2 distance, full-sample estimated AIPW nuisances
dnn_crossfitProposed DNN Z-estimator, L2 distance, K-fold cross-fitted AIPW nuisances
local_constantNadaraya-Watson smoother on the oracle AIPW score
ols_interactOLS with D*X interactions, delta-method SE at x0
causal_forestGRF causal forest, oracle nuisances (requires grf)
llfGRF causal forest with local-linear corrections and oracle nuisances (requires grf)

See also

sim_cate_run(), sim_cate_one_rep()

Examples

sim_cate_methods()
#> [1] "dnn_oracle"       "dnn_oracle_mahal" "dnn_fullsample"   "dnn_crossfit"    
#> [5] "local_constant"   "ols_interact"     "causal_forest"    "llf"
